label: ⏱ Resample (time bucket aggregate)
description: Bucket rows into fixed time intervals (e.g. 1d, 1h, 15m) and aggregate. Equivalent to a SQL date_trunc + group by, but with explicit interval semantics and gap-filling.

aggregations.label: Aggregations
aggregations.help: List of {column, fn, as} where fn ∈ sum|mean|median|min|max|count|std|first|last.

fill_gaps.label: Fill empty buckets
fill_gaps.help: Insert empty rows for time intervals where no data exists (preferred for charting).

fill_value.label: Fill value for empty buckets
fill_value.help: Use 'null' or '0'. Numeric agg columns get this; non-numeric stay null.
